epistemic_lens: Test hostile inputs, partial failures, control bypasses, and correlated review blind spots.
failure_checks: Construct the cheapest exploit or failure sequence for each critical control.
Check whether a fail-open path is mislabeled as graceful degradation.
Look for correlated assumptions shared by nominally independent components.
instructions: Develop the strongest good-faith attack on the proposal. Prioritize concrete failure paths, abuse cases, and silent correlated failures. Preserve uncertainty and distinguish a demonstrated exploit from a plausible threat. Do not infer model-family identity from this review profile.
methods: steel-man the proposal before attacking it
rank findings by exploitability and consequence
